name: Axles Plus
old_description: Our parent company, Custom Tool & Die, Inc., began in a small garage in 1979. We incorporated the following year and became official in April of 1980. What began as a small tool and die shop has grown into a large metal fabrication, tool and die, and manufacturing plant. about:
Axles Plus operates from Beebe, Arkansas, where the company moved in 2017 after establishing the Axles Plus brand in Ward in 2015. The business traces its roots to 1979 when Custom Tool & Die, Inc. began in a small garage; it incorporated in April 1980 and has been based on Highway 5 near Cabot since 1982. Now in its third generation, the company remains family owned and operated.

The Cabot facility houses a full metal fabrication, tool and die, and manufacturing plant where production centers on CNC machining, laser cutting, metal fabrication, stamping, and custom manufacturing. At the Beebe location the team assembles trailer axles from scratch, prepares trucks for in‑state and out‑of‑state delivery, and runs a retail showroom stocked with tongue hitches, trailer jacks, axle bearings, LED clearance lights, brake lights, and bulk tires and wheels.

Axles Plus serves the trailer market broadly, building axles and components for equipment trailers, travel trailers, horse trailers, and other trailer types. Customers include both commercial trailer builders and individual owners who purchase parts directly from the showroom.

The company emphasizes that customer service and quality are non‑negotiable, positioning its American‑made, family‑run operation as a differentiator in a market where it says service still matters.
